decision_scope: VALIDATE_ONLY_THE_FIRST_AUTHORED_L03_OPI_BY_EXACT_SOURCE_PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_AND_GOVERNANCE; DO_NOT_ASSERT_TRANSLATION, CREATE_CANONICAL_OPI_IDS_OR_LABELS, UNLOCK_QA_OR_OTHER_OPI, CHANGE_STR003_STR005, GENERALIZE_KE, OR_ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

validation_decisions.statement: Validate exactly one L03 OPI item: the authored internal position selector 1.
Require exact preservation of VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE as the complete closed parallel source package.
Move exactly one curriculum slot from AUTHORED to VALIDATED and leave MISSING unchanged.
Create no canonical OPI ID or label and preserve selector 1 as NONCANONICAL_STRUCTURAL_INDEX_ONLY.
If approved, open only a separate post-position-1 OPI strategy gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Curriculum validation does not promote lexical or grammar authority.
No subject/person, tense/aspect, copula or natural-language translation semantics are introduced or inferred.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
VALI FROZEN, PARAZAMI WATCH and KE CANDIDATE/non-generalized remain unchanged.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this position-1 OPI validation application while this gate remains active.
